gloss: emotional attachment; deep feeling; personal investment

definitions.gloss: emotional attachment; deep feeling; personal investment
definitions.explanation: Strong personal feelings tied to a particular thing, place, or activity — often based on memories, history, or long involvement. Usually positive: caring deeply about something.

examples.english: I have a strong attachment to this song.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{形見|かたみ}→形見：12505_katami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧{思|おも}い{入|い}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have a deep attachment to my mother's keepsake watch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{故郷|こきょう}→故郷：02733_kokyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧な{思|おも}い{入|い}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{帰|かえ}っている→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: He has a special attachment to his hometown, so he goes back every year.

notes:
Compound noun from ⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧ (thought, feeling) + ⟦{入|い}れ→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (putting in). Suggests that one has "put feelings into" something through time, memory, or effort.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {思|おも}い{入|い}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to feel attached to
- {思|おも}い{入|い}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧: to be deeply attached
- ⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧な{思|おも}い{入|い}れ: a special attachment
- ⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧{思|おも}い{入|い}れ: strong feelings about

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{愛着|あいちゃく}→愛着：04858_aichaku⟧: attachment — similar but more about possessions one is fond of
- ⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧: memory — a remembered event, not the feeling toward it
- ⟦こだわり→こだわり：08346_kodawari⟧: particular fixation — about preferences or standards, not emotional history
